findings.explanation: Your payments are conditional on the client receiving funds from third-party carriers, which means you bear the risk of delayed or defaulted payments from those carriers.
findings.suggested_change: All payments hereunder shall be payable to IMNTV in United States Dollars on a quarterly basis within thirty days of the end of each calendar quarter.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I hope you are doing well. I am looking forward to getting started and have one quick note regarding the agreement. - Regarding the relevant clause on payment terms, the current wording makes payments conditional on receiving funds from third-party carriers, which means I would bear the risk of delayed or defaulted payments; I propose changing this so that all payments are payable to IMNTV in United States Dollars on a quarterly basis within thirty days of the end of each calendar quarter. Thank you for your consideration and understanding.
